methodology.TDD: The event contract test was changed to require schema v3 and three distinct targets before the v3 evidence existed. The reusable capacity-preflight tests were added before the preflight implementation. The CPU-serving driver test required an explicit cluster before the Arena-only scripts were generalized.
methodology.EDD: The v3 manifest links immutable all-Arena RED runs, current Arena Multi-Agent promotion evidence, and the Brutus Agent 201 25-seat evidence without claiming an Oberon result that has not run.
methodology.CDD: The test contract fixes the exact catalog IDs, versions, target clusters, one-workshop affinity, no-split behavior, resource reservations, and fail-closed activation state.
methodology.BDD: Given three approved 25-seat workshops, when the read-only preflight runs, then each request must preserve its named cluster or the event remains RED before any order is created.
methodology.CBT: Event evidence, request construction, preview handling, placement mismatch denial, CPU-serving participant probes, and rendered cluster configuration are independently tested.

red.reason: The required v3 event manifest and checksum did not exist.
The participant probe still required Arena instead of an explicit expected cluster.
The non-mutating preflight implementation did not exist.

live_boundary.reason: Live certification is deferred until Arena control-plane authentication is refreshed and the Oberon and Brutus activation gates are explicitly opened.

release_boundary: GREEN applies only to the repository contract and non-mutating preflight behavior. It does not certify Oberon, Brutus repeat/soak, the combined three-cluster rehearsal, public access, or the September 17 event.
